# The Crafting Apps ArtCraft Toolbox installs and updates, in display order.
#
# Every app here must follow the release contract in docs/release-contract.md (GitHub Releases
# tagged v<version>, assets named <id>-<version>-<os>-<arch>.<ext>, SHA256SUMS.txt).
# `cargo xtask contract` checks the live releases of every entry against it.
#
# Fields:
#   id            the slug in asset names, binaries and the bundle id (ai.storyteller.<id>)
#   name          user-facing name, always {Function}Craft in PascalCase
#   tagline       one line for the app list
#   repo          GitHub owner/name that publishes the releases
#   website       optional product page
#   former_slugs  optional earlier asset-name slugs (PdfCraft shipped 0.2.x as printcraft)
#   bundle_id     optional, when it is not ai.storyteller.<id>
#   icon          optional PNG URL, when the icon isn't at the crafts' usual path
#   [app.assets]  optional, for an app outside the contract: "<os>-<arch>" = "Name_{version}.ext"
#                 (docs/release-contract.md › Apps outside the contract)
#
# Checked against GitHub on 2026-10-09: all twelve crafts publish the contract's full asset set.
schema = 1
# Bumped on every published change. A remote catalog replaces the built-in one only when its
# revision is not older (docs/architecture.md § 12).
revision = 1

# Where a newer catalog and the suite's aggregated release feed are published, signed with this
# key (`cargo xtask feed`, docs/releasing.md › The feed). One request per check instead of one
# per app, and raw.githubusercontent.com has no 60-per-hour limit. The key is pinned by this
# build: a remote catalog may move these URLs but never change the key.
[remote]
catalog = "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/smyrgeorge/artcraft-toolbox/feed/artcraft-catalog.json"
feed = "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/smyrgeorge/artcraft-toolbox/feed/artcraft-feed.json"
public_key = "ed25519:xocsWGS8OufgrZoCDrYGzTOjU3Kmw9paYoMhXJ5h5Cw="

# The toolbox itself: where its own releases are published, so it can update itself
# (docs/architecture.md § 7). Not one of the apps in the list; it follows the same release
# contract (docs/releasing.md), so the same parsers read its feed. `bundle_id` is set because the
# app id is `ai.storyteller.toolbox`, not `ai.storyteller.artcraft-toolbox`.
[toolbox]
id = "artcraft-toolbox"
name = "ArtCraft Toolbox"
tagline = "Installs, updates and launches the Crafting Apps"
repo = "smyrgeorge/artcraft-toolbox"
bundle_id = "ai.storyteller.toolbox"

[[app]]
id = "photocraft"
name = "PhotoCraft"
tagline = "Image editing: layers, masks, type and real PSD files"
repo = "storytold/photocraft"
website = "https://getartcraft.com/apps/photocraft"

[[app]]
id = "vectorcraft"
name = "VectorCraft"
tagline = "Vector illustration"
repo = "storytold/vectorcraft"
website = "https://getartcraft.com/apps/vectorcraft"

[[app]]
id = "filmcraft"
name = "FilmCraft"
tagline = "Video editing, color and sound"
repo = "storytold/filmcraft"
website = "https://getartcraft.com/apps/filmcraft"

[[app]]
id = "lightcraft"
name = "LightCraft"
tagline = "Photo library and raw development"
repo = "storytold/lightcraft"
website = "https://getartcraft.com/apps/lightcraft"

[[app]]
id = "pdfcraft"
name = "PdfCraft"
tagline = "Reading, organizing and protecting PDFs"
repo = "storytold/pdfcraft"
website = "https://getartcraft.com/apps/pdfcraft"
former_slugs = ["printcraft"]

[[app]]
id = "effectcraft"
name = "EffectCraft"
tagline = "Motion graphics and visual effects"
repo = "storytold/effectcraft"
website = "https://getartcraft.com/apps/effectcraft"

[[app]]
id = "designcraft"
name = "DesignCraft"
tagline = "Page layout and publishing"
repo = "storytold/designcraft"
website = "https://getartcraft.com/apps/designcraft"

[[app]]
id = "cadcraft"
name = "CADCraft"
tagline = "Computer-aided design and drafting"
repo = "storytold/cadcraft"

[[app]]
id = "deckcraft"
name = "DeckCraft"
tagline = "Presentations and slide shows"
repo = "storytold/deckcraft"

[[app]]
id = "gridcraft"
name = "GridCraft"
tagline = "Spreadsheets"
repo = "storytold/gridcraft"

[[app]]
id = "soundcraft"
name = "SoundCraft"
tagline = "Audio recording, editing and mixing"
repo = "storytold/soundcraft"

[[app]]
id = "wordcraft"
name = "WordCraft"
tagline = "Word processing"
repo = "storytold/wordcraft"

# ArtCraft itself (the AI studio) is a different stack and doesn't follow the contract: tags
# `artcraft-v<version>`, Tauri-style asset names, no Linux build, no SHA256SUMS.txt. Its builds
# are matched by these patterns; their digests come from the signed aggregated feed, so it can
# only be installed while that feed is published (docs/release-contract.md › Apps outside the
# contract). Windows ships an MSI only, which the toolbox doesn't install (M2), so no pattern.
[[app]]
id = "artcraft"
name = "ArtCraft"
tagline = "The AI creative studio"
repo = "storytold/artcraft"
website = "https://getartcraft.com"
bundle_id = "ai.artcraft.app"
icon = "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/storytold/artcraft/HEAD/crates/desktop/artcraft/icons/128x128.png"

[app.assets]
"macos-universal" = "ArtCraft_{version}_universal.dmg"
